caption.what_it_says: Mounting structure: no loss until architecture-specific demand index (event / design pressure ratio) reaches about 0.64; under the central screening scenario damage rises, passing half of its maximum near 1.39, and reaches a damage ratio of 0.83 (83 % of the part's value) by 1.99. The other scenarios reach half of their maximum at different demands: the lower resistance scenario near 1.14 and the upper resistance scenario near 1.58. They are alternatives, never averaged.
